parameters.name: BlockIp
parameters.description: The IP address to be blocked for brute-force attacks prevention.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Settings for paged query. The number of records to return on each page during paging. Default value: **20**, which indicates that 20 records are displayed per page.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the brute-force attacks defense rule. Valid values:
- **0**: Invalid.
- **1**: Enabled.
- **2**: Failed.
